metadata.description: Returns the details for the published version of each table defined in an account, including column definitions.

after.label: After
after.description: The paging cursor token of the last successfully read resource will be returned as the `paging.next.after` JSON property of a paged response containing more results.

archived.label: Archived
archived.description: Specifies whether to return archived tables. Defaults to `false`.

contentType.label: Content Type
contentType.description: Specifies the content type for the response.

createdAfter.label: Created After
createdAfter.description: Only return tables created after the specified time.

createdAt.label: Created At
createdAt.description: Only return tables created at exactly the specified time.

createdBefore.label: Created Before
createdBefore.description: Only return tables created before the specified time.

isGetLocalizedSchema.label: Is Get Localized Schema
isGetLocalizedSchema.description: Indicates whether to retrieve the localized schema for the tables.

limit.label: Limit
limit.description: The maximum number of results to return. Default is 1000.

sort.label: Sort
sort.description: Specifies which fields to use for sorting results. Valid fields are `name`, `createdAt`, `updatedAt`, `createdBy`, `updatedBy`. `createdAt` will be used by default.

updatedAfter.label: Updated After
updatedAfter.description: Only return tables last updated after the specified time.

updatedAt.label: Updated At
updatedAt.description: Only return tables last updated at exactly the specified time.

updatedBefore.label: Updated Before
updatedBefore.description: Only return tables last updated before the specified time.
